themes.title: Electoral Volatility and Internal Friction Facing Right-Wing Parties
themes.blurb: Right-wing and populist parties across multiple nations are grappling with internal dissension, governance accountability, and shifting voter alignments. In Sweden and France, populist parties face polling setbacks and mainstream policy co-optation, while in the US and UK, right-wing movements face campaign finance scrutiny and internal base divisions.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD experiences voter erosion nationally and in regional strongholds as mainstream parties adopt their migration platform and governance creates accountability pressures.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN navigates delicate 2027 budget negotiations while facing an economic credibility ceiling among traditional right-wing voters.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Vulnerable Republicans distance themselves from Trump in tight midterm races while internal MAGA base splits emerge over AI and technology policies.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: The party faces regulatory scrutiny from the UK election watchdog over campaign spending limits following major crypto donations.

themes.title: Challenges to Established Institutions and Norms
themes.blurb: Far-right and populist political actors continue to push against traditional democratic norms, press access, and regulatory structures. Executive actions restricting critical media outlets and efforts to centralize administrative control provoke constitutional concerns and regulatory reviews across borders.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The White House bars major news outlets, drawing First Amendment backlash, while attempting to bring health research funding under direct political control.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Electoral regulators review campaign finance framework limits in response to massive individual and crypto-billionaire contributions.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: High-stakes maneuvers surrounding the 2027 budget challenge standard legislative procedure and executive balance.

themes.title: Trump's 'America First' Global Repercussions
themes.blurb: The unilateral posture of the U.S. administration continues to reshape international relations and force domestic adaptations by foreign right-wing parties. From asserting strategic dominance over Greenland to dictating major foreign defense sales, 'America First' policies ripple through allied political debates.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump

themes.title: Enduring Influence of Populist Personalities
themes.blurb: Charismatic party figures remain the primary drivers of messaging, policy direction, and media coverage within right-wing political movements. The spotlight on figures like Donald Trump, Jimmie Åkesson, and Marine Le Pen underlines how populist political movements remain tightly tethered to the personal authority of top leadership.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and JD Vance dominate national media coverage through rallies, provocative public statements, and attacks on critics.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Jimmie Åkesson's central persona and controversial rhetoric drive public mobilization and define SD's political footprint.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's personal leadership trajectory and legal standing remain the single most defining factor in RN's strategic planning.

themes.title: Immigration Policy and Enforcement Debates
themes.blurb: Immigration management and enforcement practices remain persistent touchpoints for right-wing political agendas. Debates over detention oversight, demographic policies, and mainstream adoption of restrictive migration frameworks reflect the enduring centrality of immigration issues across borders.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
